REM ***** BASIC ***** Option Explicit
' --------------------------------------------------------- ' INICJALIZACJA FORMULARZA ' --------------------------------------------------------- Sub ZaladujKontekst_v2(oEvent As Object) Dim oForm As Object oForm = oEvent.Source If oForm.ImplementationName <> "com.sun.star.comp.forms.ODatabaseForm" Then Exit Sub
On Error Resume Next If PodgladAktywnosci_v2.g_TrybEdytora_v2 = "DODAJ" Then oForm.moveToInsertRow() oForm.updateInt(oForm.findColumn("id_pracownika"), PodgladAktywnosci_v2.g_WybranyPracownikID_v2) ElseIf PodgladAktywnosci_v2.g_TrybEdytora_v2 = "EDYTUJ" Then oForm.Filter = """id_aktywnosci"" = " & PodgladAktywnosci_v2.g_WybranaAktywnoscID_v2 oForm.ApplyFilter = True oForm.reload() End If On Error GoTo 0
PrzyStarcieEdytora(oEvent) End Sub
Sub PrzyStarcieEdytora(oEvent As Object) Dim oForm As Object oForm = oEvent.Source If oForm.ImplementationName <> "com.sun.star.comp.forms.ODatabaseForm" Then Exit Sub If PodgladAktywnosci_v2.g_WybranyOkresID_v2 = 0 Then Exit Sub
Dim sSQL As String If oForm.hasByName("lstTypAktywnosci") Then sSQL = "SELECT ka.lp || ' ' || ta.nazwa_aktywnosci, ta.id_typu " & _ "FROM pcz_oceny.typy_aktywnosci ta " & _ "JOIN pcz_oceny.konfiguracja_aktywnosci ka ON ta.id_typu = ka.id_typu " & _ "WHERE ka.id_okresu = " & PodgladAktywnosci_v2.g_WybranyOkresID_v2 & " ORDER BY ka.kolejnosc ASC" oForm.getByName("lstTypAktywnosci").ListSource = Array(sSQL) oForm.getByName("lstTypAktywnosci").refresh() End If
If oForm.hasByName("lstBonus") Then sSQL = "SELECT opis, id_bonusu FROM pcz_oceny.bonusy " & _ "WHERE id_okresu = " & PodgladAktywnosci_v2.g_WybranyOkresID_v2 & " ORDER BY mnoznik ASC" oForm.getByName("lstBonus").ListSource = Array(sSQL) oForm.getByName("lstBonus").refresh() End If End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------- ' OBSŁUGA INTERFEJSU ' --------------------------------------------------------- Sub PoWyborzeTypuAktywnosci(oEvent As Object) Dim oForm As Object, oListBox As Object oListBox = oEvent.Source.Model oForm = oListBox.Parent If IsEmpty(oListBox.SelectedValue) Then Exit Sub
Dim sSQL As String sSQL = "SELECT ta.czy_ciagla, ta.czy_udzial, ta.czy_mnoznik, ka.punkty_min, ka.punkty_max, ka.punkty_domyslne " & _ "FROM pcz_oceny.typy_aktywnosci ta " & _ "JOIN pcz_oceny.konfiguracja_aktywnosci ka ON ta.id_typu = ka.id_typu " & _ "WHERE ka.id_okresu = " & PodgladAktywnosci_v2.g_WybranyOkresID_v2 & " AND ta.id_typu = " & CInt(oListBox.SelectedValue)
Dim oStmt As Object, oResult As Object oStmt = oForm.ActiveConnection.createStatement() oResult = oStmt.executeQuery(sSQL) If Not oResult.next() Then Exit Sub
Dim bCzyCiagla As Boolean: bCzyCiagla = oResult.getBoolean(1) Dim bCzyWspol As Boolean: bCzyWspol = oResult.getBoolean(2) Dim bCzyMnoznik As Boolean: bCzyMnoznik = oResult.getBoolean(3) Dim dPktDef As Double: dPktDef = oResult.getDouble(6) Dim bMaDef As Boolean: bMaDef = Not oResult.wasNull()
Dim cDataDo As Object: cDataDo = oForm.getByName("datZakonczenia") If bCzyCiagla Then cDataDo.Enabled = True Else cDataDo.Enabled = False oForm.updateNull(oForm.findColumn("data_zakonczenia")) ThisComponent.CurrentController.getControl(cDataDo).Text = "" End If
Dim cUdzial As Object: cUdzial = oForm.getByName("numUdzial") If bCzyWspol Then cUdzial.Enabled = True Else cUdzial.Enabled = False oForm.updateDouble(oForm.findColumn("udzial_procentowy"), 100.00) ThisComponent.CurrentController.getControl(cUdzial).Value = 100.00 End If
Dim cBonus As Object: cBonus = oForm.getByName("lstBonus") If bCzyMnoznik Then cBonus.Enabled = True Else cBonus.Enabled = False oForm.updateNull(oForm.findColumn("id_bonusu")) ThisComponent.CurrentController.getControl(cBonus).selectItemPos(0, True) End If
If bMaDef And oForm.isNew Then oForm.updateDouble(oForm.findColumn("punkty_bazowe"), dPktDef) ThisComponent.CurrentController.getControl(oForm.getByName("numPunktyBazowe")).Value = dPktDef End If
PrzeliczPunktyILimity(oEvent) End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------- ' KALKULATOR MATEMATYCZNY ' --------------------------------------------------------- Sub PrzeliczPoZmianiePola(oEvent As Object) On Error Resume Next oEvent.Source.Model.commit() On Error GoTo 0 PrzeliczPunktyILimity(oEvent) End Sub
Sub PrzeliczPunktyILimity(Optional oEvent As Object) If IsMissing(oEvent) Then Exit Sub
Dim oForm As Object, oSource As Object oSource = oEvent.Source If oSource.ImplementationName = "com.sun.star.comp.forms.ODatabaseForm" Then oForm = oSource ElseIf HasUnoInterfaces(oSource, "com.sun.star.awt.XControl") Then oForm = oSource.Model.Parent Else oForm = oSource.Parent End If
If IsNull(oForm) Or IsEmpty(oForm) Then Exit Sub If Not oForm.hasByName("lstTypAktywnosci") Then Exit Sub
Dim oListBox As Object oListBox = oForm.getByName("lstTypAktywnosci") If IsEmpty(oListBox.SelectedValue) Then Exit Sub
Dim sSQL As String sSQL = "SELECT ka.punkty_min, ka.punkty_max, ta.czy_ciagla " & _ "FROM pcz_oceny.konfiguracja_aktywnosci ka " & _ "JOIN pcz_oceny.typy_aktywnosci ta ON ka.id_typu = ta.id_typu " & _ "WHERE ka.id_okresu = " & PodgladAktywnosci_v2.g_WybranyOkresID_v2 & " AND ka.id_typu = " & CInt(oListBox.SelectedValue)
Dim oStmt As Object, oResult As Object oStmt = oForm.ActiveConnection.createStatement() oResult = oStmt.executeQuery(sSQL)
Dim bCzyCiagla As Boolean, bMaMin As Boolean, bMaMax As Boolean Dim dPktMin As Double, dPktMax As Double
If oResult.next() Then dPktMin = oResult.getDouble(1): bMaMin = Not oResult.wasNull() dPktMax = oResult.getDouble(2): bMaMax = Not oResult.wasNull() bCzyCiagla = oResult.getBoolean(3) End If
Dim dMnoznikCzasuUdzialu As Double: dMnoznikCzasuUdzialu = 1.0
If bCzyCiagla Then Dim dtOd, dtDo dtOd = oForm.getDate(oForm.findColumn("data_rozpoczecia")) dtDo = oForm.getDate(oForm.findColumn("data_zakonczenia")) If Not IsEmpty(dtOd) And Not IsEmpty(dtDo) Then If dtOd.Year > 0 And dtDo.Year > 0 Then Dim dDni As Double dDni = DateDiff("d", DateSerial(dtOd.Year, dtOd.Month, dtOd.Day), DateSerial(dtDo.Year, dtDo.Month, dtDo.Day)) If dDni > 0 Then dMnoznikCzasuUdzialu = dDni / 365.25 End If End If End If
Dim dUdzial As Double dUdzial = oForm.getDouble(oForm.findColumn("udzial_procentowy")) If dUdzial > 0 Then dMnoznikCzasuUdzialu = dMnoznikCzasuUdzialu * (dUdzial / 100.0)
Dim dMnoznikBonusu As Double: dMnoznikBonusu = 1.0 Dim cBonus As Object cBonus = oForm.getByName("lstBonus") If Not IsEmpty(cBonus.SelectedValue) Then sSQL = "SELECT mnoznik FROM pcz_oceny.bonusy WHERE id_bonusu = " & CInt(cBonus.SelectedValue) oResult = oStmt.executeQuery(sSQL) If oResult.next() Then dMnoznikBonusu = oResult.getDouble(1) End If
Dim cInfoMin As Object: cInfoMin = oForm.getByName("txtPunktyMin") Dim cInfoMax As Object: cInfoMax = oForm.getByName("txtPunktyMax") If bMaMin Then cInfoMin.Text = CStr(dPktMin) Else cInfoMin.Text = "-" If bMaMax Then cInfoMax.Text = CStr(dPktMax) Else cInfoMax.Text = "-"
Dim dBazowe As Double, dOstateczne As Double dBazowe = oForm.getDouble(oForm.findColumn("punkty_bazowe")) dOstateczne = Int(((dBazowe * dMnoznikCzasuUdzialu) * dMnoznikBonusu) + 0.5)
oForm.updateDouble(oForm.findColumn("przyznane_punkty"), dOstateczne) ThisComponent.CurrentController.getControl(oForm.getByName("numPunkty")).Value = dOstateczne End Sub
' --------------------------------------------------------- ' ZAPIS I ODŚWIEŻENIE ' --------------------------------------------------------- Sub OdswiezFormularzGlowny() Dim oFormsDoc As Object, oPodgladDoc As Object oFormsDoc = ThisDatabaseDocument.FormDocuments If oFormsDoc.hasByName("frmPodgladAktywnosci_v2") Then oPodgladDoc = oFormsDoc.getByName("frmPodgladAktywnosci_v2").Component If Not isNull(oPodgladDoc) Then On Error Resume Next Dim oMainForm As Object oMainForm = oPodgladDoc.Drawpage.Forms.getByName("MainForm") If oMainForm.hasByName("SubForm_Aktywnosci") Then oMainForm.getByName("SubForm_Aktywnosci").reload() If oMainForm.hasByName("SubForm_Podsumowanie") Then oMainForm.getByName("SubForm_Podsumowanie").reload() If oMainForm.hasByName("SubForm_DaneGlowne") Then oMainForm.getByName("SubForm_DaneGlowne").reload() On Error GoTo 0 End If End If End Sub
Sub ZapiszIZamknij(oEvent As Object) Dim oForm As Object oForm = oEvent.Source.Model.Parent On Error Resume Next ThisComponent.CurrentController.getControl(oEvent.Source.Model).setFocus() On Error GoTo 0
If oForm.isNew Then oForm.insertRow() Else oForm.updateRow() OdswiezFormularzGlowny() ThisComponent.CurrentController.Frame.close(True) End Sub
Sub AnulujZmiany(oEvent As Object) ThisComponent.CurrentController.Frame.close(True) End Sub
